title: writer completion
description: The writer's only exit. Declaring a completion schema is what exposes signal_completion at all, so this file is what makes the write phase terminable.

outcome.description: ready_for_review — the chapter is complete AND every snippet placeholder has been replaced with a path the coder sent. blocked — a real dead end, nobody is coming. NOTE: waiting for a sibling's reply is NEITHER. To wait, simply end your turn without calling signal_completion: the session stays alive and the reply wakes it. Calling this tool ENDS the session and the reply is lost.

chapter_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the chapter this writer owns.

snippets_used.description: Snippet ids requested from the coder and actually included.

summary.description: One sentence: what the chapter now covers.
